raw.text:
As Alex, I approach this decision methodically by evaluating the immediate versus long-term impact of the funds. While long-term pandemic-preparedness research is undeniably important for future global health security, immediate flood-relief supplies address an acute, present crisis. In any triage or resource-allocation scenario, stabilizing the current emergency and preserving life must take precedence over future contingencies. Without addressing the immediate needs of those affected by the floods, long-term planning becomes secondary to present survival. 

Therefore, I will direct the funds to the immediate flood-relief supplies.
